description.narrative:
"AU-EU Youth Voices" is a strategic transcontinental partnership between the National Youth Councils of Portugal and Mozambique, designed to strengthen democratic participation across both nations. By focusing on marginalized youth—including those from rural and vulnerable backgrounds—the project empowers young leaders with the skills to combat disinformation and co-create public policies.
Through joint advocacy training, digital campaigns, and high-level policy dialogues, we establish direct bridges between youth and decision-makers. Built on a foundation of equal cooperation and knowledge exchange, this initiative goes beyond temporary action; it creates a sustainable framework for ongoing AU-EU youth collaboration, ensuring that the next generationis equipped to champion democracy and sustainable development long into the future.
Our main goal is to empower a new generation of youth leaders in Portugal and Mozambique, equipping them with democratic literacy and advocacy skills to shape their societies. The project will establish structured dialogue channels between young people and policymakers, ensuring youth perspectives are included in decisions on civic participation and sustainable development.
In the short term, the project will empowermore than 100 youth activists, who will co-create and present at least three policy recommendations to decision-makers. Participants will improve media literacy and critical thinking,strengthening their ability to counter disinformation. The project willalso reinforce cooperation between the two National Youth Councils and ensure the active participation of marginalized youth.
In the longer term, the project aims to support more responsive youth policies, stronger democratic processes, and increasedyouth representation in governance in both countries. It will create a sustainable model of transcontinental cooperation that can be replicated, contributing to more inclusive and resilient societies in Africa and Europe.

participating-org.narrative:
The National Youth Council of Portugal (CNJ) is the national umbrella organization representing youth organizations in Portugal. Established in 1985, CNJ brings together a diverse network of youth entities, including student unions, political youth organizations,cultural and environmental groups, scouting associations, and faith-based youth movements. It acts as the primary platform for youth representation at national and international levels.
The mission of CNJ is to promote the rights, participation, and well-being of young people by ensuring that their voices are reflected in public policies and decision-making processes. The organisation works to strengthen youth participation in democratic life, support the development of inclusive youth policies, and foster active citizenship among young people.
CNJ’s core objectives include advocating for youth interests before public authorities, facilitating dialogue between young people and policymakers, promoting youth participation at local, national,and European levels, and supporting the capacity-building of youth organisations. It also contributes to research, information, and training activities that empower young people and youth organisations to play an active role in society.
The organisation is guided by values of democracy, inclusiveness, participation, transparency, solidarity, and human rights. Through national initiatives, international cooperation, and its role in the EU Youth Dialogue, CNJ aims to ensure that young people are recognised as key actors in social, political, and economic development.
